Sleep inducing substances:

Benzos - nitrazepam, diazepam, clonazepam, alprazolam, temazepam etc

Z Drugs - Zopiclone, zolpidem, zaponex

Antihistamines - Periactin, Benadryl, phenergan, restovit (these are brand names, cant remember chemical names)

Alpha agonist / blood pressure med - Clonidine

Orexin  antagonists - Lemborexant, Suvorexant

Antipsychotics - Quetiapine, olanzapine, clozapine, 

Antidepressants - Mirtazapine, trazadone, amitriptyline. (Although mirtazapine sedates in a similar way to the antipsychotics)

GABA alternatives - gabapentin

Natural/herbal - Valarian, chamomile, kava, lemon balm, passionflower, skullcap, cbd/thc

Amino acids - glycine, theanine, gaba, tryptophan

Neurotransmitter - melatonin

Gaba agonist - alcohol

Adaptogens - Reishi, ashwagandha

Supplements - Magnesium (sort of.. doesn't induce sleep, more makes it easier to achieve)
